svg.title: Single point of failure
svg.desc: Players go through one matchmaker that keeps its queue in one Redis. When that Redis host reboots, no match can start, and 20 healthy game servers in two zones sit empty. In the second pass Redis has a replica in another zone. The same reboot causes a short pause, the replica takes over, and matches keep starting.
svg.text: One Redis goes down and every match stops. With a replica, play goes on.
